scope: Systems, storage, file transfer, DNS, monitoring, authentication, VPN, hardware, partitioning and virtualized local environments.
methodology: Inventory was deduplicated against the existing 488-app catalog by ID, name and canonical project identity before integration.
Official developer websites, repository READMEs, license texts, installation guides and release Atom feeds were reviewed. Public web search helped locate and cross-check authoritative sources.
Source supports map claims to the documents actually reviewed. Open-source licensing does not imply a no-cost prebuilt binary; unestablished pricing and exact vendor license terms remain unknown.

Release Atom timestamps describe updated feed entries, not necessarily original publication dates. Product-specific feed filtering avoids treating Ente Photos, gping pinger-library or strongSwan Android releases as desktop-product evidence.
Recommendations and tradeoffs are conditional editorial interpretations of documented capabilities. Applications were not installed, benchmarked or security-audited.
Download links target official installation/release landing pages. Reachability was checked, but no executable was downloaded, signed-binary verification performed or installer executed.

StrongSwan and SoftEther official homepages returned shell proxy placeholders. Their substantive content was separately reviewed using the web-research service; placeholder bodies are not accepted as evidence.
Research review date follows the session date; retrieval clocks are UTC and may differ. Where an early fetch omitted timestamps, the receipt identifies cache-file modification time as the basis.

excluded_candidates.name: File Browser
excluded_candidates.reason: Current official README states the project was archived 2026-09-01, will receive no further releases/security fixes, and describes unresolved command-execution and session-revocation security classes. Excluded from this expansion rather than recommended for new deployments.

important_corrections: Portainer Community Edition is limited to final CE 2.45 with fixes until August 2027; Portainer 3 is not a CE continuation.
CryFS stable 1.0 documentation is used; unsafe 2.0 alpha instructions are excluded.
inxi has moved to Codeberg; archival of the old GitHub mirror is not used to mark the current project archived.
bmon uses the Jafaral continuation identified by the earlier upstream.
Pi-hole current Core license is EUPL-1.2; Quickemu current upstream license is MIT.
Netdata has a GPL agent and separately licensed proprietary UI/cloud; SFTPGo Community theme terms prevent a uniformly open-source classification.
known_review_gaps: DiskGenius exact application EULA has not been independently reviewed; license_kind remains unknown.
Pricing remains unknown when only open-source licensing or public download links were established.
Older SSHFS-Win, Rclone Browser, PairDrop and hw-probe feed evidence does not establish recent release activity; current functionality was not tested.
Supported-platform claims distinguish host applications, server components, browser clients and bootable rescue media through platform_notes.
